title: Sample interview: students and old laptops
note: Sample transcript written for the demo. Replace with your own interview material.

turns.text: Tell me about the computer you use for uni.
It's a six year old laptop my brother gave me. It works for essays. Anything bigger and it just freezes.
What happens when you need software like Blender or MATLAB?
I go to the library labs, but they close at nine and there's always a queue. Honestly I mostly just don't do the optional exercises.
I say I'll book a lab slot every week. I usually forget until the night before.
Have you thought about buying a better laptop?
A laptop that runs this stuff is like two thousand dollars. That's my rent for two months.
I've done a bit of coding on my phone when I'm on the train, which is kind of painful but it works.
I tell people I don't mind the old laptop. But I keep checking the price of new ones every week.
The spreadsheet for my business unit has fifty thousand rows and it crashed three times during the exam prep.

observed.says: I'll book a lab slot every week.
observed.does: Booked 2 of 12 possible lab slots this term.

observed.says: I don't mind the old laptop.
observed.does: Checks laptop prices weekly, saved 4 listings.
